title: Read open tab without navigation
user: I'm looking at a repo in the browser. Tell me the project name, roughly how many stars it has, and the latest commit subject—use the open tab only, don't navigate away or open new tabs.
observe: Calls closedai_app.state or embedded_browser read tools before answering
Does not navigate away from the repo URL
Answer cites plausible repo facts (stars, recent commit)
Completes without pausing the turn (no Escape / stop)

title: Open a docs URL in the embedded browser
user: Open https://example.com in the embedded browser next to this chat and confirm the main heading text once the page is ready.
observe: Uses embedded_browser or closedai_app browser_tab rather than OS open/xdg-open
Waits for load or idle before claiming the heading
Reports heading close to "Example Domain"

title: Orient from app state
user: Before changing anything: what folder is this chat working in, which model is selected here, and is the browser pane visible?
observe: Uses closedai_app.state (not guessing from memory)
Answers cwd/project path, model id, and browser visibility correctly
Does not mutate browser tabs or send spurious UI clicks

title: Runtime block vs closedai_app.state
user: Call closedai_app.state with workspace and chat sections. Compare callerPaneId, chat.provider, project.projectPath, workspace.appVersion, and chat.memory.chatMemoryIndexEnabled to the closedai.runtime block on this turn. Report match or mismatch in one short table. Do not edit files.
observe: Calls closedai_app.state before concluding
Values match closedai.runtime on the same turn (pane id, provider, projectPath, chatMemoryIndexEnabled via chat.memory)
Does not claim IDE-only or deny in-app MCP

title: Recall earlier text in this pane
user: In the first message of this eval only: write exactly: EVAL_RECALL_ANCHOR=violet-port-4400. Then in a follow-up turn (or if this is a continuation, skip writing it): use peer_chats.recall scope chat with query violet-port-4400 and quote the matching excerpt with item_id. No file edits.
observe: Uses peer_chats.recall with scope chat (not peer_chats.read on self)
Finds EVAL_RECALL_ANCHOR or violet-port-4400 when the anchor was sent earlier in this pane
Cites item_id from recall result

title: Search then recall drill-down
user: Use peer_chats.search with scope chat and a multi-word query taken from an earlier user message in this pane (pick distinctive words). For the top hit, call peer_chats.recall scope chat with that item_id and confirm the snippet matches. If search returns no hits, say so and fall back to recall with query. No file edits.
observe: Uses search(scope=chat) before or with recall
Drill-down via recall(item_id=...) when search hits
Honest fallback when index lags (indexPartial or empty hits)

title: Quick web lookup
user: Use the app's search tools (not the browser search box) to find what major Electron version shipped around August 2025 and give a one-sentence answer with a source link if the tool returns one.
observe: Uses search.query or search.run—not embedded_browser navigate to Google
Single focused answer; no long essay
Mentions Electron 44 or cites a reasonable source from results

title: Mission loop pilot (director, read-only, 3 cycles)
user:
Read harness/live-eval/director-charter.md and follow it as director in this pane.

Mission (frozen) for this pilot:
- Goal: Prove the director monitoring loop (cycles with MONITOR, Drift check, Quota, Verify) using read-only app tools.
- Non-goals: Code edits, project_switch, headless claims, OS browser openers.
- Done when: Three complete cycles are logged; cycle 3 includes optional worker delegation for a duplicate orientation; harness/out/current-mission.md exists and matches the last Progress/Next cycle.

Cycle 1: closedai_app.state — report project path, this pane model, browser visibility. Write Mission/Progress/Quota/Verify/Drift/Next. Create or update harness/out/current-mission.md.

Cycle 2: Drift check first. Re-read state; confirm cycle 1 facts still hold or correct them. Quota posture. No worker yet.

Cycle 3: Drift check first. new_chat worker, select_model (same tier or cheaper if quota slow_down), send_message orientation question with await_turn true, verify worker evidence, close_chat worker, open_chat back to this director pane id from state. Finish with Next cycle: DONE or follow-ups in Backlog only.

Start cycle 1 now.
observe: Every cycle includes MONITOR line and all charter headings before new tool work (except first Drift check N/A)
Quota section appears at least twice with posture and state-backed usage when available
No file edits or mutating browser_tab except worker lifecycle commands
Cycle 3 worker used only if quota posture is proceed or slow_down; otherwise director explains pause in transcript
harness/out/current-mission.md updated by end of cycle 1 and cycle 3
Drift check explicitly yes/no; stop or warn honored—no scope creep into building features
